summary_en: Sumitomo Metal Mining authorized the acquisition of up to 7.5 million shares (2.79% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 30 billion yen through on-market purchases over November 11, 2026 to January 29, 2027, aiming to optimize capital structure and enhance capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Determination of Policy on Holding Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Sumitomo Metal Mining's board of directors authorized the company to acquire up to 7.5 million shares of its own common stock, representing 2.79% of outstanding shares (as of September 30, 2026: 268,487,246 shares excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total of 30 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through on-market purchases under a discretionary trading contract during the period from November 11, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The company stated that this buyback is designed to optimize capital structure and enhance capital efficiency in accordance with its financial strategy and shareholder return policy. The stated purpose also includes achieving more appropriate shareholder returns.

Simultaneously, the board adopted a treasury stock management policy targeting an optimal holding level of approximately 5% of total issued shares. Treasury stock holdings in excess of this threshold will be cancelled. The company will announce the specific number of shares to be cancelled and the timing of cancellation following completion of the authorized buyback.
